title: 4-11 March, First Asian Games held in Delhi.
text: The Asian Games, also known as Asiad, is a continental multi-sport event held every four years for athletes of Asia. The Games were regulated by Asian Games Federation from the first Games in New Delhi, India in 1951, until the 1978 Games.

title: Central Railway is formed by the merger of several government-owned railways.
text: The Central Railway is one of the 18 zones of Indian Railways. Its headquarters are located at Mumbai.

title: Western Railway is formed by merging smaller railways.
text: The Western Railway is one of the 19 zones of Indian Railways and is among the busiest railway networks in India, headquartered at Mumbai, Maharashtra. The major railway routes of Indian Railways which come under Western Railways are: Mumbai Central–Ratlam, Mumbai Central–Ahmedabad and Palanpur–Ahmedabad.

title: Salar Jung Museum is opened to the public by the Prime Minister of India Jawaharlal Nehru.
text: The Salar Jung Museum is an art museum located at Dar-ul-Shifa, on the southern bank of the Musi River in the city of Hyderabad, Telangana, India. It is one of the notable National Museums of India.
